messages.Vores indkøbsliste og madønsker.\n\nVælg:
Shared shopping lists and meal requests.

Choose Foodie as your home app for a dedicated kitchen tablet. You can change this in Settings > Choose default home app.

When lock screen display is enabled, anyone holding the tablet can view and edit the lists while Foodie is visible. Other apps still require normal unlocking.

An internet connection is needed to sync lists. Login is remembered until the household password changes or app data is cleared.
Include these meals in next week's plan. Buy required_shopping_items. Do not buy already_purchased_items again, including as recipe ingredients. Plan the remaining meals and ingredients yourself. Reset only after the order is completed, using this response's revision.
